operating_notes.text: BSE granted in-principle approval (April 24, 2026) for direct listing of 10,49,37,280 existing ₹1 shares; valid 45 days; no new capital raised.
BSE trading approval (letter dated May 11, 2026) received; 10,49,37,280 existing ₹1 shares listed and tradable on BSE from May 12, 2026 under direct listing.

ICRA assigned [ICRA] BBB+ (Stable) to ₹145 Cr of bank limits — ₹121.50 Cr fund-based cash credit (YES Bank ₹70 Cr, IndusInd ₹31.50 Cr, ICICI ₹20 Cr) and ₹23.50 Cr unallocated; no short-term rating disclosed.
FY26 inventory of ₹232.07 Cr equals 67% of FY26 revenue of ₹344.08 Cr, with operating cash flow at ₹-15.8 Cr.
Q4FY26 revenue of ₹66.43 Cr is the balancing figure between audited FY26 and nine-month FY26 results.
Auditor's Annexure A states the internal audit system needs to be strengthened to match the company's size and business.
Q2FY27 revenue of ₹85.86 Cr is less than half Q1FY27's ₹182.57 Cr, showing a strong seasonal skew within the half.
H1FY27 operating cash flow of ₹103.74 Cr came with inventories down to ₹102.43 Cr from ₹232.07 Cr at March.
Q2FY27 EBITDA margin of 4.96% compares with 15.45% in Q2FY26 and 9.39% in Q1FY27.

Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹66.43 Cr; net profit ₹4.41 Cr (+4.5% YoY).
